query:
WITH FamilyMemberCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.head_of_household_id,
        w.wealth_level,
        COUNT(d.id) AS member_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
    JOIN estishraf_llm_wealth_index w 
        ON d.head_of_household_id = w.head_of_household_id
    WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح'
      AND d.death_date IS NULL
    GROUP BY d.head_of_household_id, w.wealth_level
),
ChildCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        f.wealth_level,
        AVG(f.member_count - 1) AS avg_children_per_family
    FROM FamilyMemberCounts f
    GROUP BY f.wealth_level
)
SELECT 
    wealth_level,
    ROUND(avg_children_per_family, 2) AS average_children_count
FROM ChildCounts
ORDER BY 
    CASE wealth_level
        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Lower Middle' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Middle' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Upper Middle' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Rich' THEN 5
    END LIMIT 20000
